name: Chronicle 2.0
tagline: AI-powered presentation builder that produces polished decks without the generic, over-designed AI aesthetic.
problem: Most AI presentation tools churn out visually cluttered or templated slides that feel impersonal and require heavy manual cleanup. Chronicle 2.0 addresses the gap between speed and quality, letting teams create professional presentations quickly without sacrificing design integrity. It removes the friction of fighting generic AI output so communicators can focus on their message.
useCases: Building investor pitch decks with a distinctive, branded look
Creating client-facing proposals and project updates
Producing internal team presentations and strategy documents
Turning reports or written content into structured slide narratives
